selected_script.angle: Vertical wall organization clears floor clutter and keeps wet mops organized
selected_script.hook: Tired of your brooms and mops constantly falling over and creating a messy pile on the floor?

video_001_part_01.0-3s_pain_conflict: A messy utility closet floor where several brooms and mops are precariously stacked, slipping and falling over in a disorganized heap.
video_001_part_01.3-6s_product_solution: A hand easily clicks a wet mop handle into one of the white roller clip positions of the light-gray wall-mounted holder on a smooth tiled wall.
video_001_part_01.6-10s_fast-cut_scene_1: Close-up showing the secure grip of the white spring-loaded silicone roller clip holding a broom handle firmly in place without slipping.

video_001_part_02.0-4s_fast-cut_scene_2: A different angle showing small cleaning brushes and spray bottles hanging neatly from the light-gray J-hooks directly beneath the clips.
video_001_part_02.4-8s_fast-cut_scene_3: The complete horizontal bar organizing five tools vertically inside a clean laundry room, keeping the floor completely clear.
video_001_part_02.8-10s_cta: Overlay text reads: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.' with a clean shot of the organized space.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in a realistic handheld phone-shot style. 0-3s: Close-up of a messy utility closet floor where brooms and a wet mop slip and fall over, showing the frustration of cluttered space. 3-6s: Transition to a clean, light-gray tiled wall where a light-gray horizontal mop holder with exactly five white silicone roller clips and five J-hooks is mounted. A hand clicks a mop handle into one clip. 6-10s: Close-up of a broom handle snapping securely into the white roller clip mechanism. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. Keep the visual identity consistent: light-gray plastic body, white rollers, light-gray hooks, and slim horizontal bar.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in a realistic handheld phone-shot style, continuing the previous segment. 0-4s: Fast-cut scene showing small cleaning accessories like a blue duster and cleaning cloth being hung on the light-gray J-hooks under the bar. 4-8s: Wide shot showing the entire unit holding five upright brooms and mops neatly on the laundry-room wall, with the floor underneath completely clear. 8-10s: Short, clean CTA showing the organized wall layout with text overlay: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.' Keep the identical product identity, pacing, light-gray color, and matte plastic texture.
